title: Baby★LOVE
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Seara Arisugawa, a sixth grader who looks like a high schooler, has loved Shuhei Seto, an older boy, since she was little; when her parents move to the US for a time, she moves into his family's house and, with his little sister Koharu's help, sets out to make him fall for her (MANGA MILLION blurb via AniList; MangaUpdates). A nine-volume Shueisha shoujo romance-comedy with love rivals and an OVA adaptation.
life_message: It celebrates wholehearted, persistent first love and a girl's determination (to verify).

content.note: A sixth-grade girl pursues an older boy she lives with (AniList Age Gap; MangaUpdates Older Male Younger Female, Live-in Lover); Shuhei's age unstated in sources. MangaDex rates it safe. (to verify)
A child passing as older to pursue an older boy (MangaUpdates Appearance Different from Actual Age).
